title: 第11章 祖地碰上美少女第12章 墨家先祖
slug: 我气运之子反派系统什么鬼
content_zh:
墨羽以为她被自己吓到了，不禁心头一软。
“我不是故意要凶你的。”
“没、没关系的！”
楚玉璃连忙抬起头，声音有些急促，生怕墨羽误会。
师尊见她不高兴，竟会主动道歉。
比他上一个师尊好太多了。
她也更加确定了，师尊一定是个好人。
有些东西，从一个人的日常行为就能看出。
楚玉璃将灵力注入到手中的青岚月华裙。
裙子仿佛有了生命一般，轻盈地舒展开来，自动穿在了她的身上。
她低头看了看，又在墨羽面前转了一圈，裙摆飞扬，如同仙子下凡。
“师尊，怎么样，好看吗？”
美眸中既有欣喜，又含着期待。
没有少女会不喜欢漂亮的裙子。
墨羽的眼中闪过惊艳之色。
“好看！”
眼前的楚玉璃，肌肤胜雪，眉目如画，明眸清澈见底，宛若一汪清泉。
身着青岚月华裙，裙摆点缀星光，宛若银河洒落其间。
腰间一条淡青色丝带，勾勒出她纤细的腰肢，更添几分柔美。
虽身段还未发育完全，但已初见玲珑曲线，如含苞待放的花蕾，散发着青春的魅力。

尤其是那纤细的腰肢，盈盈一握，让人忍不住想要搂在怀里。
此刻的她，美得不可方物。
与最初那个脏兮兮小丫头模样判若两人。
这般绝色，恐怕也只有他山头那些师姐能与之相媲美了。
被墨羽称赞，楚玉璃有些不好意思，脸颊微微泛红，低垂螓首，手指轻轻绞着裙角。
此时的楚玉璃更加动人，但墨羽没有太多时间欣赏，他祭出飞剑。
“走吧，先和我回一趟我家。”
楚玉璃略微迟疑，有些害怕，但还是轻轻点头，莲步轻移，踏上飞剑。
“师尊的家？您没有宗门吗？”
“回家处理些事情，之后再去宗门。”
墨羽简短地回答，跃上飞剑，站在楚玉璃身前，御剑而起。
为了照顾楚玉璃，压低了飞行高度，飞剑在低空缓缓掠过。
“要见父母了吗？”
楚玉璃小声嘀咕。
“嗯？”
墨羽的听觉何其敏锐，自然听到了她的低语。
“我……我只是有些好奇……”
楚玉璃绝美的脸上露出慌乱的神色。
“我没有父母，家那边，也没有人了。”
墨羽淡淡开口，无喜无怒。

“啊？”
楚玉璃一怔，美眸中闪过惊讶，随即涌上一抹浓浓的心疼。
content_en:
Mo Yu thought she was scared by him, and couldn't help but feel soft.
"I didn't mean to hurt you."
"No, it's okay!"
Chu Yuli quickly raised her head, her voice a little hurried, for fear that Mo Yu would misunderstand.
When the master saw that she was unhappy, he actually apologized.
Much better than his last master.
She also became more certain that Master must be a good person.
Some things can be seen from a person's daily behavior.
Chu Yuli poured spiritual power into the Qinglan Yuehua skirt in her hand.
The skirt seemed to have come to life, stretching out lightly and automatically put on her body.
She looked down and then spun around in front of Mo Yu, her skirt flying like a fairy descending to earth.
"Master, how are you doing? Does it look good?"
There was both joy and expectation in her beautiful eyes.
There is no girl who doesn’t like beautiful dresses.
Mo Yu's eyes flashed with surprise.
"Good looking!"
The Chu Yuli in front of her had skin that was better than snow, her features were picturesque, and her bright eyes were as clear as a clear spring.
Wearing a Qinglan Yuehua skirt, the skirt is dotted with starlight, just like the Milky Way falling in it.
A light cyan ribbon around her waist outlined her slender waist, adding a bit of softness.
Although her figure is not yet fully developed, she has already begun to show her exquisite curves, like a bud waiting to bloom, exuding the charm of youth.
Especially the slender waist, which makes people want to hold her in their arms.
She was incredibly beautiful at this moment.
She looks completely different from the dirty little girl she was at the beginning.
With such stunning beauty, I am afraid that only his senior sisters at the top of the mountain can rival her.
Chu Yuli was a little embarrassed to be praised by Mo Yu, her cheeks turned slightly red, her head lowered, and her fingers gently twisted the corners of her skirt.
Chu Yuli was even more moving at this time, but Mo Yu didn't have much time to appreciate it, so he used his flying sword.
"Let's go, come back to my house with me first."
Chu Yuli hesitated slightly, a little scared, but still nodded gently, moved her steps lightly, and stepped onto the flying sword.
"Master's home? Don't you have a sect?"
"Go home and take care of some things, and then go to the sect."
Mo Yu answered briefly, jumped on the flying sword, stood in front of Chu Yuli, and rose with the sword.
In order to take care of Chu Yuli, the flying height was lowered, and the flying sword passed slowly at low altitude.
"Are you going to meet your parents?"
Chu Yuli whispered.
"Huh?"
Mo Yu's hearing was so keen that he naturally heard her whisper.
"I...I'm just a little curious..."
Chu Yuli's beautiful face showed a panic look.
"I have no parents, and there is no one at home."
Mo Yu spoke calmly, neither happy nor angry.
"Huh?"
Chu Yuli was startled, surprise flashed in her beautiful eyes, and then she felt a deep sense of distress.
